mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_work_order (tenant_id, title, content, contact_name, contact_phone, status, assignee_user_id, complete_note, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{completeNote}, #{idempotentKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, title, content, contact_name, contact_phone, status, assignee_user_id, complete_note, idempotent_key, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_work_order WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
